LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_ArrivedText1: The documents from {0} have arrived by drop pod near your trade beacons or colony center. The fleet expects every one of them back intact.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_ArrivedText2: Sealed document crates have landed near your trade beacons. The attached manifest is signed by {0}: 'Processed, stamped, and returned in full.'
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_ArrivedText3: The fleet's backlogged paperwork has arrived. {0} requests that processing begin at the earliest opportunity — the clerical division is already behind schedule.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_DestroyedText1: Documents under the fleet contract have been destroyed. As stipulated, the contract has ended. The quest has failed.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_DestroyedText2: Part of the fleet's paperwork is beyond recovery. There is nothing left to return in full, and the contract has ended. The quest has failed.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_DestroyedText3: The fleet's documents were destroyed in your care. {0} has been notified. The quest has failed.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_CompleteText1: Every document has been processed and accounted for. As promised, payment has been dispatched.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_CompleteText2: The last file has been verified and crated for return. {0} confirms the contract is fulfilled; payment is on its way.
LanguageData.DMS_DocQuest_CompleteText3: All fleet paperwork has been processed on schedule. {0} notes that follow-up contracts may be offered to us first.
